reply.english: I don't know, but it's cloudy.

dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.arabic: صَبَاح الْخَيْر يَا سَعِيد، شِنُو الْجَوّ الْيَوْم بِرَايِك؟
dialogue.transliteration: Sabaa7 ilkheer ya sa3iid, shnu ijjaw ilyawm biraayik?
dialogue.english: Good morning Said, what do you think the weather's like today?

dialogue.speaker: سعيد
dialogue.arabic: صَبَاح النُّور. الْجَوّ غَيِّم شْوَي، بَس مَا فِيهِ بَرْد
dialogue.transliteration: Sabaa7 innuur. ijjaw ghayyyim shwayy, bas ma fiih bard
dialogue.english: Good morning. It's a bit cloudy, but not cold.

dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.arabic: يَعْنِي رَاح تِمْطُر بِرَايِك؟
dialogue.transliteration: ya3ni raa7 timTur biraayik?
dialogue.english: So do you think it'll rain?

dialogue.speaker: سعيد
dialogue.arabic: مَا أَدْرِي، بَس فِي هَوَا كْتِير مِن الصَّبَّاح
dialogue.transliteration: ma adri, bas fi hawa ktiir min iSSabbaa7
dialogue.english: I don't know, but there's been a lot of wind since morning.

dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.arabic: أَنَا حَاسَّة إِنُّو الدُّنْيَا أَحَاار مِن أَمَس
dialogue.transliteration: ana 7assit innu idduunya a7aarr min amas
dialogue.english: I feel like it's hotter than yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: سعيد
dialogue.arabic: لاَ، أَنَا حَاسّ الْعَاكِس، الْجَوّ صَار أَبْرَد شْوَي
dialogue.transliteration: la, ana 7ass il3aakis, ijjaw Saar abrad shwayy
dialogue.english: No, I feel the opposite, it's gotten a bit colder.

dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.arabic: الْمُهِمّ، شُفْت الشَّمْس طَالِعَة؟
dialogue.transliteration: ilmuHimm, shift ishshams Taal3a?
dialogue.english: Anyway, did you see the sun's out?

dialogue.speaker: سعيد
dialogue.arabic: إِي، بَس مِغْطَّاة بِالْغَيْم شْوَي
dialogue.transliteration: ii, bas mighTTaaye bilgheem shwayy
dialogue.english: Yes but it's a bit covered by clouds.

dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.arabic: خُذ شَمْسِيَّة مَعَاك عَلَى كُلّ حَال
dialogue.transliteration: khudh shamsiyya ma3aak 3ala kull 7aal
dialogue.english: Take an umbrella with you just in case.

dialogue.speaker: سعيد
dialogue.arabic: حَاسِن، تِمَّ ذَكَّرْتِينِي
dialogue.transliteration: 7aasin, timm dhakkartiini
dialogue.english: OK, good you reminded me.

dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.arabic: الَّلَّه يِعْطِيك الْعَافِيَّة، أَشُوفُك بَعِدَيْن
dialogue.transliteration: allaa yi3Tiik il3aafiyya, ashuufak ba3adeyn
dialogue.english: Take care, see you later.

response.english: Yes, bring something heavy with you.
Yes, a lot of wind since morning.

lessons.culture: بِصَنْعَاء النَّاس تِتْحَاكَى عَنِ الْجَوّ كْتِير كِنَوْع مِنَ الْحَدِيث الْخَفِيف، خَاصَّة أَوَّل الصَّبَّاح وَقُبْل مَا تِطْلُع مِنَ الْبَيْت. كَلِمَة "الدُّنْيَا" تِنِسْتَخْدَم بِدَل "الْجَوّ" كْتِير.

exercises.prompt: صَاحِبُك بِيْسَأَلُك: "شِنُو الْجَوّ الْيَوْم؟". جَاوِبُ إِنُّو الْجَوّ حِلْو وَفِيهِ شَمْس.

too_formal.feedback: This is correct but sounds like a formal weather report, not everyday speech.

exercises.prompt: حَدّ سَأَلَك: "عِم تِمْطُر هَسْع؟" وَأَنْتَ شَائِف الشَّمْس. جَاوِبْ بِاللاَّ.

too_formal.feedback: Grammatically fine, but it is more elaborate and bookish than a quick spoken answer.

exercises.tip: جَوَاب قَصِير وَسَرِيع هُوَ الطَّبِيعِي بِالْحَكِي الْيَوْمِي.

exercises.prompt: كَمِّل الْجُمْلَة: "عِم _____ بَرَّا مِنَ الصَّبَّاح." الْمَعْنَى: It's been raining outside since morning.

too_formal.feedback: This is Modern Standard Arabic phrasing, not how rain is described in spoken Yemeni.

exercises.tip: الْفِعْل "تِمْطُر" هُوَ الْفِعْل الْعَادِي لِلْمَطَر بِالْيَمَنِي.

exercises.prompt: كَمِّل الْجُمْلَة: "لاَزِم تَاخِذ _____ مَعَاك، رَاح تِمْطُر." الْمَعْنَى: You need to take an umbrella with you, it's going to rain.

too_formal.feedback: This is the standard Arabic word for umbrella; Yemenis say "شَمْسِيَّة" in daily speech.

exercises.prompt: تَرْجِم لِلْهِجَة الْيَمَنِيَّة: "The weather is very cold today."

too_formal.feedback: This is a formal, written-style sentence rather than how it is said in conversation.

exercises.tip: بِالْحَكِي الْيَوْمِي بِنْقُول "بَارِد" أَوْ "بَرْد" وَمَا منْقُول "شَدِيد الْبُرُودَة".

exercises.prompt: تَرْجِم لِلْهِجَة الْيَمَنِيَّة: "There's a lot of wind today."

too_formal.feedback: Correct meaning, but "الرِّيَاح" is the formal written word; spoken Yemeni uses "هَوَا".

exercises.prompt: شِنُو مَعْنَى "الْجَوّ غَيِّم"؟

too_formal.feedback: This describes the same meaning but in a formal written register.

exercises.prompt: شِنُو بِتْقُول لِحَدّ لاَزِم يَاخِذ شَمْسِيَّة مَعْهُ؟

too_formal.feedback: Grammatically correct but far too formal for a casual reminder.

exercises.prompt: رَتِّب الْكَلِمَات لِتَصِير جُمْلَة: "الْجَوّ / حِلْو / اليوم / شَمْس / وَفِيهِ"

too_formal.feedback: Same meaning, but this is a more literary, written-style phrasing.

exercises.tip: رَتِّب الْوَصْف بَعْد كَلِمَة "الْجَوّ" وَاسْتَخْدِم "و" لِرَبْط الصِّفَات.

exercises.prompt: رَتِّب الْكَلِمَات لِتَصِير جُمْلَة: "مَعَاك / شَمْسِيَّة / تَاخِذ / لاَزِم"

too_formal.feedback: This carries the same meaning but in an unnaturally formal, written tone.

exercises.tip: الْجُمْلَة الْعَادِيَّة تَبْدَأ بِـ"لاَزِم" ثُمَّ الْفِعْل.

phrases.english: In winter it gets very cold in Sana'a.

phrases.arabic: مَا بِحِبّ الشِّتَا لأَنُّو بِيْبِرِد كْتِير
phrases.transliteration: ma bi7ibb ishshita la2annu byibrid ktiir

dialogue.speaker: سارة
dialogue.arabic: شِنُو أَحْلَى فَصْل عِنْدَك يَا مُحَمَّد؟
dialogue.transliteration: shnu a7la faSl 3indak ya mu7ammad?
dialogue.english: What's your favorite season, Muhammad?

dialogue.speaker: محمد
dialogue.arabic: بِحِبّ الرَّبِيع كْتِير، الْجَوّ بِيْكُون مَعْتَدِل
dialogue.transliteration: bi7ibb irrabii3 ktiir, ijjaw bykuun mu3tadil
dialogue.english: I really like spring, the weather's mild.

dialogue.speaker: سارة
dialogue.arabic: أَنَا بِالْعَاكِس، بِحِبّ الصَّيْف، بِحِبّ الْحَاار
dialogue.transliteration: ana bil3aakis, bi7ibb iSSayf, bi7ibb il7aarr
dialogue.english: I'm the opposite, I like summer, I like the heat.

dialogue.speaker: محمد
dialogue.arabic: بَس بِالصَّيْف الْجَوّ بِيْكُون جَافّ كْتِير بِصَنْعَاء
dialogue.transliteration: bas biSSayf ijjaw bykuun jaff ktiir biSan3aa
dialogue.english: But in summer the weather's really dry in Sana'a.

dialogue.speaker: سارة
dialogue.arabic: إِي صَحِيح، بَس مَا بِيْمْطُر وَهَذَا شَيْء مَنِيح
dialogue.transliteration: ii Sa7ii7, bas ma bymTur w haadha shay manii7
dialogue.english: Yeah true, but it doesn't rain and that's a good thing.

dialogue.speaker: محمد
dialogue.arabic: أَنَا مَا بِحِبّ الشِّتَا خَالِص، بِيْبِرِد كْتِير
dialogue.transliteration: ana ma bi7ibb ishshita khaliS, byibrid ktiir
dialogue.english: I don't like winter at all, it gets very cold.

dialogue.speaker: سارة
dialogue.arabic: بَس بِيْتْلِج عَلَى الْجِبْل، وَهَذَا حِلْو نِطْلَع نِتْفَرَّج
dialogue.transliteration: bas bitlij 3ala ijjibl, w haadha 7ilw niTla3 nitfarraj
dialogue.english: But it snows on the mountain, and that's nice to go see.

dialogue.speaker: محمد
dialogue.arabic: صَحِيح، مَرَّة طَلَعْنَا عَالْجِبْل بِالشِّتَا وَكَانَ حِلْو كْتِير
dialogue.transliteration: Sa7ii7, marra Tala3na 3aljib bishshita w kaan 7ilw ktiir
dialogue.english: True, once we went up the mountain in winter and it was really nice.

dialogue.speaker: سارة
dialogue.arabic: وَشِنُو رَايِك بِالْخَرِيف؟
dialogue.transliteration: w shnu raayik bilkhariif?
dialogue.english: And what do you think about fall?

dialogue.speaker: محمد
dialogue.arabic: بِحِبّ لَمَّا الْوَرَق يِبْدَأ يِطِيح، بِصِير الْجَوّ حِلْو وَهَادِي
dialogue.transliteration: bi7ibb lamma ilwara2 yibda yiTii7, biSiir ijjaw 7ilw w haadi
dialogue.english: I like when the leaves start falling, the weather becomes nice and calm.

dialogue.speaker: سارة
dialogue.arabic: مَعَاك حَقّ، كُلّ فَصْل إِلُو جَمَالُو
dialogue.transliteration: ma3aak 7a22, kull faSl ilu jamaalu
dialogue.english: You're right, every season has its own beauty.

pair.english: Does it rain a lot in winter?

response.english: Yes, and it snows on the mountain too.

pair.english: What do you think of the summer heat?

response.arabic: بِحِبُّو، بَس بِيْصِير جَافّ كْتِير أَحْيَان
response.transliteration: bi7ibbu, bas biSiir jaff ktiir a7yaan
response.english: I like it, but it gets too dry sometimes.

response.arabic: إِي، بِيْصِير الْجَوّ مَعْتَدِل وَالْوَرَق يِطِيح
response.transliteration: ii, biSiir ijjaw mu3tadil w ilwara2 yiTii7
response.english: Yes, the weather gets mild and the leaves fall.

lessons.culture: بِصَنْعَاء الصَّيْف بِيْكُون طَوِيل وَحَاار وَجَافّ، وَالشِّتَا أَوِ الثَّلْج بِيْصِير غَالِباً مِن دِيسِمْبِر لِفِبْرَايِر. الثَّلْج عَلَى الْجِبْل قَرِيب مِنَ الْمَدِينَة شَيْء يُحِبّ النَّاس يِطْلَعُو يِتْفَرَّجُو عَلَيْهِ.

exercises.prompt: حَدّ سَأَلَك: "شِنُو أَحْلَى فَصْل عِنْدَك؟". جَاوِبْ إِنَّك بِتْحِبّ الصَّيْف.

too_formal.feedback: This is grammatically correct but sounds like a written answer, not spoken conversation.

exercises.prompt: حَدّ سَأَلَك: "هَسْع شِنُو الْفَصْل؟" وَأَنْتَ بِمِنْتَصِف دِيسِمْبِر. جَاوِبْ إِنُّو الشِّتَا.

too_formal.feedback: This is grammatically fine but far more formal than how the answer is normally given.

exercises.prompt: كَمِّل الْجُمْلَة: "بِالشِّتَا لاَزِم _____ شَيْء ثِقِيل." الْمَعْنَى: In winter you need to wear something heavy.

too_formal.feedback: This is the formal written word for "wearing"; spoken Yemeni uses "تِلْبَس".

exercises.tip: كَلِمَة "تِلْبَس" هِيَ الْكَلِمَة الْمَحْكِيَّة لـ"يَلْبَس" أَوْ "اللِّبَس".

exercises.prompt: كَمِّل الْجُمْلَة: "عِم _____ عَلَى الْجِبْل." الْمَعْنَى: It's snowing on the mountain.

too_formal.feedback: This is the formal way to describe snowfall; spoken Yemeni just says "يِتْلِج".

exercises.prompt: تَرْجِم لِلْهِجَة الْيَمَنِيَّة: "I don't like winter because it gets very cold."
exercises.answer: ما بحب الشتا لأنو بيبرد كتير
accepted: ما بحب الشتا لأنو بيبرد كتير
ما بحب الشتا لأنه بيبرد كتير
أنا ما بحب الشتا لأنو بيبرد كتير

too_formal.item: لاَ أُحِبّ فَصْل الشِّتَاء لأَنَّ الْجَوّ يَصِير بَارِداً جِداً
too_formal.feedback: This is a correct but written-style sentence, not how it would be spoken.

exercises.prompt: تَرْجِم لِلْهِجَة الْيَمَنِيَّة: "Spring is my favorite season."
accepted: بحب الربيع أكتر من كل الفصول

too_formal.feedback: Correct meaning, but "فَصْلِي الْمُفَضَّل" is a more written, formal phrasing.

exercises.tip: "أَحْلَى فَصْل عِنْدِي" هِيَ الطَّرِيقَة الْمَحْكِيَّة الْعَادِيَّة.

exercises.prompt: أَي فَصْل بِيْتْلِج فِيهِ عَالْجِبْل قَرِيب مِن صَنْعَاء؟

too_formal.feedback: Same meaning, just using the formal written word for winter instead of the spoken one.

exercises.prompt: شِنُو مَعْنَى "الْجَوّ جَافّ"؟

too_formal.feedback: Correct meaning but expressed in a formal, written register.

exercises.prompt: رَتِّب الْكَلِمَات: "فَصْل / أَحْلَى / الرَّبِيع / عِنْدِي"

too_formal.item: الرَّبِيع هُوَ أَجْمَل فَصْل بِالنِّسْبَة لِي
too_formal.feedback: Same meaning but phrased in a more literary, written way.

exercises.prompt: رَتِّب الْكَلِمَات: "كْتِير / بِصَنْعَاء / طَوِيل / بِيْكُون / الصَّيْف"

too_formal.item: يَكُون فَصْل الصَّيْف فِي صَنْعَاء طَوِيلاً جِداً
too_formal.feedback: This carries the same meaning but in a formal written structure.

exercises.tip: رَتِّب: الْمَوْضُوع، مَكَان، فِعْل، ثُمَّ الْوَصْف.

phrases.arabic: لاَزِم بُوت بِالشِّتَا لأَنُّو بِيْمْطُر كْتِير
phrases.transliteration: lazim boot bishshita la2annu bymTur ktiir

phrases.arabic: اِلْبَس شَيْء مَرِيح لأَنُّو رَاح نِمْشِي كْتِير
phrases.transliteration: ilbas shay mrii7 la2annu raa7 nimshi ktiir

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: شِنُو لاَزِم أِلْبَس الْيَوْم؟ مَا بِأَعْرِف شِنُو الْجَوّ
dialogue.transliteration: shnu lazim albas ilyawm? ma bia3raf shnu ijjaw
dialogue.english: What should I wear today? I don't know what the weather's like.

dialogue.speaker: علي
dialogue.arabic: الْجَوّ بَارِد شْوَي، اِلْبَسِي كِنْزَة
dialogue.transliteration: ijjaw barid shwayy, ilbasi kinza
dialogue.english: It's a bit cold, wear a sweater.

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: وَشَمْسِيَّة لاَزِم؟
dialogue.transliteration: w shamsiyya lazim?
dialogue.english: And do I need an umbrella?

dialogue.speaker: علي
dialogue.arabic: إِي، رَاح تِمْطُر بَعِد الظُّهْر حَسِب النَّشْرَة
dialogue.transliteration: ii, raa7 timTur ba3id iDDuh r 7asab innashra
dialogue.english: Yes, it's going to rain in the afternoon according to the forecast.

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: طَيِّب رَاح أِلْبَس بُوت كَمَان، مَا بِأَحِبّ رِجْلِي تِصِير مَبْلُولَة
dialogue.transliteration: Tayyib raa7 albas boot kamaan, ma bia7ibb rijli tiSiir mablula
dialogue.english: Ok I'll wear boots too, I don't like my feet getting wet.

dialogue.speaker: علي
dialogue.arabic: فِكْرَة مَنِيحَة، وَخُذِي جَاكِيت لأَنُّو رَاح يِبِرِد بِالْلَّيْل
dialogue.transliteration: fikra manii7a, w khudhi jaakeet la2annu raa7 yibrid billeel
dialogue.english: Good idea, and take a jacket because it'll get cold at night.

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: نِسِيت الْمِطْرِيَّة أَمَس وَرِجِعْت مَبْلُولَة كُلِّي
dialogue.transliteration: niseet ilmiTrayyah amas w rijit mablula kulli
dialogue.english: I forgot the raincoat yesterday and I came back completely soaked.

dialogue.speaker: علي
dialogue.arabic: وَلاَ يِهِمَّك، هَسْع ذَكَّرْتِك، خُذِيهَا مَعَاك
dialogue.transliteration: w la yhimmak, has3 dhakkartak, khudihaa ma3aak
dialogue.english: Don't worry, I just reminded you, take it with you.

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: شُكْرَاً، وَشِنُو رَايِك بِهَاذَا اللَّون؟ مِنَاسِب لِلْجَوّ؟
dialogue.transliteration: shukran, w shnu raayik bhaadha illawn? mnaasib lijjaw?
dialogue.english: Thanks, and what do you think of this color? Is it suitable for the weather?

dialogue.speaker: علي
dialogue.arabic: إِي مِنَاسِب، بَس خُذِي نَضَّارَتُك الشَّمْس كَمَان لأَنُّو الشَّمْس رَاح تِطْلُع بَعِدَيْن
dialogue.transliteration: ii mnaasib, bas khudhi naDDaartak ishshams kamaan la2annu ishshams raa7 tiTla3 ba3adeyn
dialogue.english: Yes it's fine, but take your sunglasses too because the sun will come out later.

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: تَمَام، جَهَّزْت كُلّ شَيْء هَسْع
dialogue.transliteration: tamaam, jahhazit kull shay has3
dialogue.english: Great, I've got everything ready now.

pair.english: What should I wear, it's cold?

response.english: Wear a sweater and a jacket.

pair.english: Do I need an umbrella today?

response.transliteration: ii, raa7 timTur ba3id iDDuh r
response.english: Yes, it's going to rain in the afternoon.

pair.english: What do you wear in summer?

response.english: I wear shorts and a light shirt.

pair.english: Why do you need boots in winter?

response.arabic: لأَنُّو بِيْمْطُر كْتِير وَتِصِير الأَرْض مَبْلُولَة
response.transliteration: la2annu bymTur ktiir w tiSiir il2arD mablula
response.english: Because it rains a lot and the ground gets wet.

lessons.culture: بِصَنْعَاء النَّاس بِتِلْبَس كَذَا طَبَقَة بِالشِّتَا (كِنْزَة تَحْت جَاكِيت) لأَنُّو الْجَوّ بِيْتِغَيَّر بَيْن الصَّبَّاح وَالْلَّيْل. الشَّمْسِيَّة وَالْمِطْرِيَّة شَيْء أَسَاسِي بِالشَّنْطَة أَوِ السَّيَّارَة مِن دِيسِمْبِر لِفِبْرَايِر.

exercises.prompt: صَاحِبَتُك سَأَلَتْك: "شِنُو لاَزِم أِلْبَس الْيَوْم؟" وَأَنْتِ عَارِفَة الْجَوّ بَارِد. جَاوِبِيهَا.
accepted: البسي شي ثقيل لأنو الجو بارد

too_formal.feedback: This is grammatically fine but is written-register phrasing, not casual spoken advice.

exercises.tip: "اِلْبَس شَيْء ثِقِيل" هِيَ النَّصِيحَة الْمَحْكِيَّة الْعَادِيَّة.

exercises.prompt: حَدّ سَأَلَك: "لاَزِم شَمْسِيَّة الْيَوْم؟" وَأَنْتَ عَارِف رَاح تِمْطُر. جَاوِبْ بِالإِيجَاب.

too_formal.feedback: This is a formal weather-report style answer rather than a quick spoken reply.

exercises.prompt: كَمِّل الْجُمْلَة: "حَطّ _____ الشَّمْس، الشَّمْس قَوِيَّة." الْمَعْنَى: Put on your sunglasses, the sun is strong.

too_formal.feedback: This is the correct object but phrased as a formal noun label, not spoken instruction.

exercises.prompt: كَمِّل الْجُمْلَة: "نِسِيت _____ بِالْبَيْت." الْمَعْنَى: I forgot the raincoat at home.

too_formal.feedback: This is a formal descriptive phrase rather than the single common spoken word.

exercises.prompt: تَرْجِم لِلْهِجَة الْيَمَنِيَّة: "You need boots in winter because it rains a lot."
exercises.answer: لازم بوت بالشتا لأنو بيمطر كتير
accepted: لازم بوت بالشتا لأنو بيمطر كتير
لازم بوت بالشتا لأنه بيمطر كتير
بالشتا لازم بوت لأنو بيمطر كتير

too_formal.item: يَجِب اِرْتِدَاء الأَحْذِيَة الْمُطْرِيَّة فِي الشِّتَاء لأَنَّ الأَمْطَار تَهْطُل كَثِيراً
too_formal.feedback: Correct meaning, but this is a formal written sentence.

exercises.prompt: تَرْجِم لِلْهِجَة الْيَمَنِيَّة: "I didn't wear a jacket and I got cold."

too_formal.feedback: Same meaning but written in a formal literary structure.

exercises.prompt: شِنُو بِتِلْبَسِي بِالصَّيْف عَادَة؟

too_formal.feedback: Correct meaning but a more elaborate, written phrasing of the same clothes.

exercises.tip: بِالصَّيْف الْجَوّ حَاار فَبِنِلْبَس لِبَاس خَفِيف.

exercises.prompt: لِيشْ بِتِلْبَسِي نَضَّارَة الشَّمْس؟

too_formal.feedback: Correct meaning but phrased with the more formal word "أَشْعَّة".

exercises.tip: النَّضَّارَة بِتِحْمِيك عُيُونُك مِنَ الشَّمْس الْقَوِيَّة.

exercises.prompt: رَتِّب الْكَلِمَات: "مَعَاك / شَمْسِيَّة / تِمْطُر / رَاح / خُذ"

too_formal.item: خُذْ مَعَك مِظَلَّة لأَنَّ الأَمْطَار سَتَهْطُل
too_formal.feedback: Same meaning but with formal connectors and vocabulary.

exercises.prompt: رَتِّب الْكَلِمَات: "بِالْبَيْت / الْمِطْرِيَّة / نِسِيت"

too_formal.item: لَقَدْ نَسِيت مِعْطَف الْمَطَر فِي الْمَنْزِل
too_formal.feedback: Same meaning, more formal sentence construction with "لَقَدْ".

exercises.tip: اِبْدَأْ بِالْفِعْل "نِسِيت" ثُمَّ الشَّيْء ثُمَّ الْمَكَان.

phrases.arabic: الْجَوّ مِش مَنِيح، بِدْنَا نِلْغِي الطَّلْعَة
phrases.transliteration: ijjaw mish manii7, bidna nilghi iTTal3a

phrases.arabic: مَا فِيّ أِطْلُع، الْجَوّ حَاار كْتِير
رَاح نِقْعُد عَالشُّرُفَة الْلَّيْلَة، الْجَوّ لَطِيف
لأَنُّو رَاح تِمْطُر، خَلِّينَا نِأَجِّل السَّهْرَة
phrases.transliteration: la2annu raa7 timTur, khalliina ni2ajjil issahra

reply.arabic: إِي، قَالُو رَاح تِمْطُر بَعِد الظُّهْر
reply.transliteration: ii, 2aalu raa7 timTur ba3id iDDuh r
reply.english: Yes, they said it'll rain in the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: هناء
dialogue.arabic: شِنُو رَايِك نِطْلُع الْحَدِيقَة الْيَوْم؟
dialogue.transliteration: shnu raayik niTla3 il7adeega ilyawm?
dialogue.english: What do you think about going to the park today?

dialogue.speaker: محمود
dialogue.arabic: شُفْتِ نَشْرَة الْجَوّ؟ أَنَا سِمِعْت رَاح تِمْطُر بَعِد الظُّهْر
dialogue.transliteration: shifti nashrit ijjaw? ana simi3t raa7 timTur ba3id iDDuh r
dialogue.english: Did you see the weather forecast? I heard it's going to rain in the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: هناء
dialogue.arabic: لاَ مَا شُفْتِهَا، بَس الْجَوّ هَسْع حِلْو كْتِير
dialogue.transliteration: la ma shiftiha, bas ijjaw has3 7ilw ktiir
dialogue.english: No I didn't see it, but the weather's really nice right now.

dialogue.speaker: محمود
dialogue.arabic: إِذَا الْجَوّ مَنِيح هَسْع، يَلاَّ نِطْلُع بِسُرْعَة قُبْل مَا يِتِغَيَّر
dialogue.transliteration: idha ijjaw manii7 has3, yalla niTla3 bisr3a 2abil ma yitghayyar
dialogue.english: If the weather's good for now, let's go out quickly before it changes.

dialogue.speaker: هناء
dialogue.arabic: طَيِّب، بَس إِذَا مَطَرَت نِرْجَع الْبَيْت مُبَاشِرَة
dialogue.transliteration: Tayyib, bas idha maTarat nirja3 ilbayt mubaashara
dialogue.english: Ok, but if it rains we'll go back home right away.

dialogue.speaker: محمود
dialogue.arabic: حَاسِن. وَشِنُو نِعْمِل إِذَا الْجَوّ مَا يِسْمَح؟
dialogue.transliteration: 7aasin. w shnu ni3mil idha ijjaw ma yismah?
dialogue.english: Alright. And what will we do if the weather doesn't allow it?

dialogue.speaker: هناء
dialogue.arabic: نِأَجِّل الطَّلْعَة وَنِقْعُد بِالْبَيْت نِتْفَرَّج عَ فِيلِم
dialogue.transliteration: ni2ajjil iTTal3a w nig3ud bilbayt nitfarraj 3a fiilim
dialogue.english: We'll postpone the outing and stay home to watch a movie.

dialogue.speaker: محمود
dialogue.arabic: فِكْرَة حِلْوَة، بَس بِتِمَنَّى الْجَوّ يِضَلّ مَنِيح
dialogue.transliteration: fikra 7ilwa, bas bitmanna ijjaw yiDhall manii7
dialogue.english: Good idea, but I hope the weather stays nice.

dialogue.speaker: هناء
dialogue.arabic: أَنَا كَمَان، طَالِمَا الْجَوّ مَنِيح نِضَلّ طَالِعِين
dialogue.transliteration: ana kamaan, Talima ijjaw manii7 niDhall Taal3iin
dialogue.english: Me too, as long as the weather's good we'll keep going out.

dialogue.speaker: محمود
dialogue.arabic: طَيِّب وَالرَّحْلَة لِلْجِبْل يَوْم الْجُمُعَة، شِنُو رَايِك؟
dialogue.transliteration: Tayyib w irri7la liljib yawm iljum3a, shnu raayik?
dialogue.english: Ok and the trip to the mountain on Friday, what do you think?

dialogue.speaker: هناء
dialogue.arabic: هَاي كَمَان عَلَى حَسِب الْجَوّ، بِشُوف النَّشْرَة يَوْم الْخَمِيس
dialogue.transliteration: hayy kamaan 3ala 7asab ijjaw, bishuuf innashra yawm ilkhamis
dialogue.english: That also depends on the weather, I'll check the forecast on Thursday.

pair.english: Are we going to the park today?
Why do you want to cancel the outing?

response.arabic: لأَنُّو الْجَوّ مِش مَنِيح وَرَاح تِمْطُر
response.transliteration: la2annu ijjaw mish manii7 w raa7 timTur
response.english: Because the weather's not good and it's going to rain.

pair.english: Did you see the forecast for today?

response.arabic: إِي، قَالُو الْجَوّ حَاار وَفِي رِيح
response.english: Yes, they said it's hot and windy.

pair.english: The weather doesn't allow us to play outside?

response.arabic: إِي، حَاار كْتِير وَفِي ريح قَوِيَّة
response.transliteration: ii, 7aarr ktiir w fi rii7 gawiyyah
response.english: Yes, it's very hot and the wind is strong.

lessons.culture: بِصَنْعَاء الطَّقْس يِتِغَيَّر سَرِيع بَيْن الْفُصُول، فَالنَّاس دَائِماً بِتِفْكِّر فِي الْجَوّ قُبْل مَا تِخَطِّط لِأَي طَلْعَة أَوْ رَحْلَة. إِن شَاء الَّلَّه هُوَ تَعْبِير شَائِع جِداً عِنْد الْحَدِيث عَنِ الْمُسْتَقْبَل.

exercises.prompt: صَاحِبُك سَأَلَك: "شِنُو رَايِك نِطْلُع الْحَدِيقَة؟" وَالْجَوّ حِلْو. جَاوِبْهُ بِالْمَوَافَقَة.
exercises.answer: إي، الجو حلو وإن شاء الله
accepted: إي، الجو حلو وإن شاء الله

too_formal.item: نَعَمْ، يُمْكِنُنَا الْخُرُوج إِذَا كَانَ الطَّقْس مُلاَئِماً
too_formal.feedback: This is grammatically correct but sounds like a written response, not everyday speech.

exercises.tip: الْجَوَاب الْبَسِيط مَع "إِن شَاء الَّلَّه" طَبِيعِي.

exercises.prompt: حَدّ سَأَلَك: "شِنُو رَايِك نِقْعُد بِالْبَيْت الْيَوْم؟" وَالْجَوّ بَارِد. جَاوِبْ بِالْمَوَافَقَة.

too_formal.item: مِنَ الأَفْضَل أَنْ نَبْقَى فِي الْمَنْزِل لأَنَّ الطَّقْس بَارِد
too_formal.feedback: Correct but sounds like a formal proposal rather than casual agreement.

exercises.prompt: كَمِّل الْجُمْلَة: "إِذَا الْجَوّ مَنِيح، نِ_____ الْحَدِيقَة." الْمَعْنَى: If the weather's nice, we'll go to the park.

too_formal.feedback: This is the standard word but less colloquial; Yemeni speakers use "نِطْلُع".

exercises.prompt: كَمِّل الْجُمْلَة: "طَالِمَا الْجَوّ مَنِيح، نِ_____ طَالِعِين." الْمَعْنَى: As long as the weather's good, we'll keep going out.

too_formal.feedback: This is correct but formal; spoken Yemeni uses "نِضَلّ" (we continue/stay).

exercises.prompt: تَرْجِم لِلْهِجَة الْيَمَنِيَّة: "If it rains tomorrow, we'll postpone the trip."
accepted: إذا في مطر بكرة نأجل الرحلة

too_formal.item: إِذَا هَطَلَتِ الأَمْطَار غَداً، سَوْف نُؤَجِّل الرِّحْلَة
too_formal.feedback: Correct meaning but formal phrasing with "سَوْف".

exercises.prompt: تَرْجِم لِلْهِجَة الْيَمَنِيَّة: "The weather doesn't allow us to play outside."

too_formal.item: الطَّقْس لاَ يَسْمَح لَنَا بِاللَّعِب فِي الخَارِج
too_formal.feedback: Correct but formal with "بِاللَّعِب" instead of colloquial "نِلْعَب".

exercises.prompt: شِنُو تِقُول إِذَا الْجَوّ مَنِيح وَتَبِّ تِطْلُع؟

too_formal.feedback: Same meaning, but it sounds like a formal proposal rather than casual speech.

exercises.prompt: الْرَّحْلَة لِلْجِبْل شِنُو تِعْتِمِد عَلَيْهِ؟

too_formal.feedback: Same meaning, just using "حَالَة الطَّقْس" (condition of the weather) instead of just "الْجَوّ".

exercises.tip: الْرَّحْلَات الْخَارِجِيَّة دَائِماً تِعْتِمِد عَلَى الْجَوّ.

exercises.prompt: رَتِّب الْكَلِمَات: "الْحَدِيقَة / نِطْلُع / مَنِيح / الْجَوّ / إِذَا"

too_formal.item: إِذَا كَانَ الطَّقْس جَيِّداً، فَسَوْف نَذْهَب إِلَى الْحَدِيقَة
too_formal.feedback: Same meaning but with formal structure including "كَانَ" and "سَوْف".

exercises.tip: الشَّرْط بِـ"إِذَا" ثُمَّ الشَّرْط ثُمَّ النَّتِيجَة.

exercises.prompt: رَتِّب الْكَلِمَات: "الْجَوّ / نِلْغِي / الطَّلْعَة / مِش / مَنِيح / بِدْنَا"
exercises.answer: الجو مش منيح بدنا نلغي الطلعة
accepted: الجو مش منيح بدنا نلغي الطلعة

too_formal.item: إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنِ الطَّقْس جَيِّداً، يَجِب أَنْ نُلْغِي الرِّحْلَة
too_formal.feedback: Same meaning but formal with "يَجِب أَنْ" and past tense structure.

challenge.title: طَلْعَة بِالْجَوّ الصَّحِيح
challenge.instructions: حَدِّث عَنْ طَلْعَة قُمْت فِيهَا مَع أَصْحَابُك. اسْتَخْدِم الْكَلِمَات الَّتِي تَعَلَّمْتِهَا عَنِ الْجَوّ وَالْفُصُول وَالْلِّبَاس الْمِنَاسِب.
required_elements: describe the weather when you went out

dialogue.speaker: أَحْمَد
dialogue.arabic: طَلَعْنَا الْحَدِيقَة أَمَس، الْجَوّ كَانَ حِلْو كْتِير
dialogue.transliteration: Tala3na il7adeega amas, ijjaw kaan 7ilw ktiir
dialogue.english: We went to the park yesterday, the weather was really nice.

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: شِنُو الْفَصْل الْحِين؟
dialogue.transliteration: shnu ilfaSl il7een?
dialogue.english: What season is it now?

dialogue.speaker: أَحْمَد
dialogue.arabic: الرَّبِيع، وَالشَّمْس طَالِعَة وَالهَوَا رايِح
dialogue.transliteration: irrabii3, w ishshams Taal3a w ilhawa raay7
dialogue.english: Spring, and the sun is out and there's a nice breeze.

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: شِنُو لِبِسْتُو؟
dialogue.transliteration: shnu libsitu?
dialogue.english: What did you wear?

dialogue.speaker: أَحْمَد
dialogue.arabic: أَنَا لِبِسْت شَيْء خَفِيف وَحَطِيت شَمْسِيَّة، أَنْتِ لَبِسْتِ إِيش؟
dialogue.transliteration: ana libist shay khafiif w 7aTTit shamsiyya, inti libsti iish?
dialogue.english: I wore something light and took an umbrella. What did you wear?

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: أَنَا لِبِسْت فِستَان وَنَضَّارَتِي، الْجَوّ كَانَ مَنِيح
dialogue.transliteration: ana libist fistaan w naDDaarati, ijjaw kaan manii7
dialogue.english: I wore a dress and my sunglasses, the weather was pleasant.
